prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Children’s educational story illustration matching the reference: warm light watercolor and colored pencil on fine cream paper, soft hand-drawn contours, sunlit muted pastel palette, rounded natural proportions. Same cute East Asian child, short dark brown hair, orange-red short sleeve shirt, blue trousers. Concrete unambiguous actions for preschoolers. No text, letters, captions, numerals, arrows, icons, watermarks or decorative frames. Asset: EXACT regular 3 columns by 3 rows action-card atlas, SQUARE canvas of nine equal SQUARE cells; strict grid, no labels, tiny cream separators. Same child, low table, colorful wooden CUBES and CYLINDERS ONLY; two open wooden boxes with painted red CUBE picture and blue CYLINDER picture, NO letters. Each cell independent, main subjects fully contained with safe margin, hands and contents obvious. ROW-MAJOR: (1) FALLEN: colorful cubes and cylinders scattered only on floor, child hands empty, low table empty. (2) PICK: child bent down taking a cylinder from floor with one hand while setting a cube onto low table with other; remaining loose blocks on floor. (3) SORT: ALL blocks on tabletop, child actively separates them into two pure groups, left cubes only, right cylinders only, both boxes EMPTY; floor clear. (4) PUT: child puts one cube into cube box and one cylinder into cylinder box, correct same-kind contents visible, table remains only a few matching leftovers, floor clear. (5) DONE: ALL cubes neatly in cube box, ALL cylinders neatly in cylinder box, table and floor otherwise clear, child empty hands. (6) BUILD: child stacking a tall tower of cubes and cylinders on table, both storage boxes still EMPTY, floor clear. (7) MIXED BOX: child drops a cube and a cylinder into SAME box, cubes and cylinders visibly mixed together inside that single box; other box EMPTY. (8) completely BLANK cream-white. (9) completely BLANK cream-white. No arrows, check/cross marks, word/numerals or other shapes. Depict toys and actions, not abstract icons.
review: 通过：仅圆柱与方块；散落地上/捡到桌上/按形状分类/分别装盒/收好/搭塔空盒/混装一盒均明确。末两格空白。
